pkgmetadata.longdescription: qinda's local coding-model server: llama.cpp's llama-server in router mode (qinda-llm.service) over the models from sci-ml/gguf-coding-models, with an API key for coding agents on the tailnet, plus LLM Server mode (qinda-llm-server.target): a boot without SDDM or the desktop that shows the qinda-llm-top console on tty1. Adds the "LLM Server" row to the QindaQt boot menu.
